Change c0521. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): Be steady to your purposes, and firm as a rock.

1818 text: This ice is not made of such stuff as your hearts might be; it is mutable, cannot withstand you, if you say that it shall not.

1831 text: This ice is not made of such stuff as your hearts may be; it is mutable, and cannot withstand you, if you say that it shall not.

Diff: This ice is not made of such stuff as your hearts [-might-] {+may+} be; it is mutable, {+and+} cannot withstand you, if you say that it shall not.

Context after (unchanged): Do not return to your families with the stigma of disgrace marked on your brows.

result.rationale: Swaps 'might' for 'may' and inserts 'and' before 'cannot withstand you'; these are grammatical and stylistic tweaks that leave the meaning of Walton's speech to the crew unchanged.
